name: 11f-convert-mistral-empty-prefix-on
description: The one empty-input shape where the reference itself FAILS: with `mistral.enablePrefix` on, `const lastMsg = messages[messages.length - 1]` is `undefined` and the `lastMsg?.role === 'assistant'` test dereferences it (:711), so the whole call throws instead of returning []. The port cannot throw the same TypeError, but it must still fail rather than quietly return a value -- it indexes the empty list the same way. The oracle compares the PRESENCE of an error, not its text, so this fixture checks that both sides refuse the input; the sane empty-array case is 11d, where the flag is off and both sides return the untouched empty array.
